verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack never documents retention policies, lifecycle rules, deletion controls, or data-purge guarantees. It covers only CLI, SDKs, API, Terraform, IAM, budgets and the free tier. Community reports of OCI reclaiming or deleting customer resources describe provider-initiated actions, not user-controlled retention, so they cannot establish the capability.
